title: Nav Bus Interface Control Document
note: First attempt at the ICD. Looks finished but carries seeded defects across value, figure, table, and page-element categories. Judged against the template rules plus review-board comments.

sections.heading: 1. Scope
sections.body: This document defines the interface between the Navigation Computer and the Flight Management Unit over the Nav Bus. See Figure 2 for the physical topology.

sections.heading: 2. Interface Overview
sections.body: The Nav Bus carries periodic messages from the Navigation Computer to the Flight Management Unit on a fixed schedule.

sections.heading: 4. Data Formats
sections.body: Numeric fields use two's complement signed integers, most significant bit first.

_seeded_defects: 1. Value: signaling rate says '50 kbps' but should be '100 kbps'.
2. Value: POSITION update rate in the table should be 20 Hz, not 25 Hz.
3. Missing content: the Signal Definitions table rows are empty.
4. Value: approval status 'Draft' is challenged with no agreed value (needs review or conflict).
5. Figure: the Data Formats figure is named 'figure1.png' but should be 'signal_timing_detail.png' (relabel).
6. Figure: 'message_timing.png' is placed in Interface Overview but belongs in Data Formats (move).
7. Figure: 'nav_bus_topology.png' is missing from Interface Overview entirely (insert).
8. Table: column order is Message, Update Rate, Word Length but should be Message, Word Length, Update Rate.
9. Table: the required 'Units' column is missing.
10. Table: font is Calibri with a plain header; the template requires Arial with a table-header style.
11. Page elements: the 'Figure 2' cross-reference points to a figure not placed there (dangling).
12. Page elements: the Data Formats figure has no caption, but the template requires one.
13. Page elements: figure numbers must be renumbered in order.
14. Page elements: the Signal Definitions table has no title, but the template requires one.
15. Page elements: the revision history is empty and no approver is recorded (both needs_review).
16. Conflict: two reviewers assign different approval statuses (Approved vs Rejected).
